items.label: Sturdy Patio Furniture
items.value: This modern outdoor furniture set is made of solid powder coated steel frame, rustproof and sturdy; hand-woven resin wicker offers high tensile strength, water resistance, which is strong enough to withstand all-weather variations for long service life.

items.label: Comfortable Outdoor Couch
items.value: Comes with 3-inch thick lofty sponge padded cushions, the modern patio sectional couch providing with extraordinary comfort while relaxing in your leisure time, suitable for entertaining your neighbors or friends. Note: cushions are not water-proof；（When you don' t use it, advise you to take cushions inside or buy a cover for longer service time）

items.label: Easy Cleaning and Maintain
items.value: Our patio conversation set features a water proof wicker and glass top for the coffee table, easy for wipe cleaning; zippered cushion covers are made of superior fabric, fade resistant, water spill repellent and washable.

items.label: Convertible Patio Set
items.value: Each part of this 5- piece patio furniture could be used separately, easily allowing to be combined into different configurations according to your needs. Ottoman also can be an extra seating or part of a chaise lounge; Ideal for outdoor patio, porch, backyard, balcony, garden and poolside.

items.label: Assembly and Support
items.value: The patio furniture set includes: 1 x armless sofa, -2 x corner sofa, 1 x ottoman, 1 x coffee table.If there is any problem, please feel free to contact us(Login to your amazon account>choose "Your orders" > find the order ID > click"Contact seller").

items.label: Item dimensions
items.value: 77 x 26.7 x 25.2 inches. The product is not large, please be careful with the size!

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly is required. The product comes unassembled and includes instructions for assembly.
